limitations.note: The patch correctly registered the counter but also removed the `ready_b` guard, so an accepted first byte now replaces the accumulator when `ready_b` is low instead of being added to it as in the reference.

The scoreboard cleared its sum after every four accepted bytes regardless of `ready_b`, so the backpressure tests validated the patch’s new behavior rather than detecting the mismatch with the reference.
